name: autoapply-ai
description: AutoApply AI - Autonomous AI Job Hunter & Application Automation Platform

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:server && npm run build:workers && npm run build:client
scripts.dev: node ./node_modules/concurrently/dist/bin/concurrently.js -k -n "server,workers,client" -c "blue,green,magenta" "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:workers" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.test: node ./node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --config server/vitest.config.ts && node ./node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --config workers/vitest.config.ts
